Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:
(For Ankur...)

Anneke gets drunk on some XTC-laced blood. After Frederick the Weak
(who has gone Out of the Frying Pan) snaps her out of her addiction, she
decides to reward him by calling an Alastor vote naming FtW, which passes.

Unfortunately, while Anneke was out of it, it turns out that some mean
Harbingers of Skulls Slaughterhouse'd all the Assault Rifles. So when
her controller goes through his library to find a weapon, he comes up
empty.

Is Frederick still an Alastor, or does the vote's effects fizzle?

Alastor: Choose a ready Camarilla vampire. If this referendum is
successful, search your library for an equipment card and place this
card and the equipment on the chosen vampire. Pay half the cost (round
down) of the equipment. This vampire may enter combat with any vampire
controlled by another Methuselah as a +1 stealth (D) action. This
vampire cannot commit diablerie. A vampire may have only one Alastor.

--Colin McGuigan

> Is Frederick still an Alastor, or does the vote's effects fizzle?

Trick question, since you use the Waste Management Operation to put an
Assault Rifle back into your deck. (You did call Alastor during your
discard phase, didn't you?)

> Alastor: Choose a ready Camarilla vampire. If this referendum is
> successful, search your library for an equipment card and place this
> card and the equipment on the chosen vampire. Pay half the cost (round
> down) of the equipment. This vampire may enter combat with any vampire
> controlled by another Methuselah as a +1 stealth (D) action. This
> vampire cannot commit diablerie. A vampire may have only one Alastor.

Seriously speaking, the statements on the Alastor card are separated by
periods. Each happens. The order is unimportant since at this point
(successful) the card's effects are considered atomic. You couldn't say,
"interrupt" this card's effects in order prevent the "no diablerie"
consequence.

Ankur
